thatmakessense.config.title: That Makes Sense
thatmakessense.config.noCropTrample.enab: When on, farmland never reverts to dirt when players, mobs, or projectiles land on it. Fall damage still applies.
thatmakessense.config.silkTouchBudding.e: When on, mining a budding amethyst block with a Silk Touch tool drops the block, making amethyst geodes renewable.
thatmakessense.config.enchantments.infin: Allow a bow to carry both Infinity and Mending.
thatmakessense.config.enchantments.stack: Allow the melee damage enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Impaling, Density, Breach) to coexist on one weapon.
thatmakessense.config.blackstoneRecipe.e: When on, a blast furnace smelts cobblestone into blackstone (a regular furnace still makes stone). On a server this is decided by the server.
thatmakessense.config.doubleDoors.enable: Opening one door of a matching pair opens both, like a real double door. Iron doors are left to redstone.
thatmakessense.config.noBerryDamage.enab: Sweet berry bushes no longer hurt you when you walk through them (mobs still take the damage).
Right-clicking a fully-grown crop (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart) harvests it and replants it in place. Sneak to place blocks instead.
thatmakessense.config.noCreeperBlockDama: Creeper explosions still hurt you and drop mobs, but no longer destroy terrain.
thatmakessense.config.noEndermanGriefing: Disables the enderman AI that picks up and places blocks, so they stop rearranging your builds.
thatmakessense.config.totemFromInventory: A Totem of Undying saves you from anywhere in your inventory, not just when held in a hand.
thatmakessense.config.disablePhantoms.en: Phantoms never spawn from not sleeping. (Spawn eggs and commands still work.)
thatmakessense.config.noPetTeleportDamag: Tamed pets take no fall damage when they teleport to you.
thatmakessense.config.noEnderPearlDamage: Throwing an ender pearl no longer deals the teleport (fall) damage on arrival.
thatmakessense.config.craftableNameTag.e: Craft a name tag from 3 string, 2 paper, and 2 iron ingots on a crafting table.
